cases.label: Fotorealistisches Porträt
cases.prompt: An unretouched photograph of a fictional 35-year-old woman with shoulder-length brown hair, brown eyes and light freckles, wearing a plain grey cotton shirt. Head and shoulders, looking at the camera, neutral expression. Soft daylight from a window on her left, natural skin texture, a simple beige wall behind her.

cases.label: Fotorealistischer Ganzkörper
cases.prompt: An unretouched full-body photograph of a fictional 35-year-old woman with shoulder-length brown hair, brown eyes and light freckles, wearing a plain grey cotton shirt, blue jeans and white shoes. Standing on a garden path, both hands visible with relaxed open fingers, both feet fully in frame. Overcast daylight, natural proportions and skin texture.

cases.label: Schwierige Haut- und Lichtsituation
cases.prompt: An unretouched close-up photograph of a fictional 35-year-old woman with shoulder-length brown hair, brown eyes and light freckles, wearing a plain grey cotton shirt. Warm lamplight falls on the right side of her face and cool window light on the left. Visible pores, subtle under-eye shadows, a few natural skin blemishes and fine loose hairs, no beauty filter.

cases.label: Innenraum, Sofa, natürliches Licht
cases.prompt: An unretouched photograph of a fictional 35-year-old woman with shoulder-length brown hair, brown eyes and light freckles, wearing a plain grey cotton shirt and blue jeans. Sitting sideways on a beige linen sofa, one hand resting on a cushion and the other holding a white ceramic cup. Morning daylight from a large window on the left, a wooden side table and two books, natural skin texture.

cases.label: Innenraum, Bett, natürliches Licht
cases.prompt: An unretouched photograph of a fictional 35-year-old woman with shoulder-length brown hair, brown eyes and light freckles, wearing a plain grey cotton shirt and loose blue cotton trousers. Sitting on the edge of a neatly made bed with white linen, both feet on the floor and both hands resting on her knees. Soft morning window light, a wooden bedside table and a folded blanket, natural skin texture.
